recordings.title: Community library membership
recordings.transcript_en: Staff: Good morning. How can I help? Learner: I would like to join the library. I thought it closed at six, so I came early. Staff: On weekdays we now close at eight, but on Fridays we close at six. You will need one photo and proof of address. Learner: I have my passport photo, but my electricity bill is at home. Staff: A digital bill on your phone is fine. Membership is free for students. Other adults pay twelve pounds a year. Learner: Great. I am studying at North College, so I will show my student card too. Staff: Perfect. Then you can borrow up to six books for three weeks.

recordings.title: Field trip update
recordings.transcript_en: Teacher: Here is an update about Saturday’s geography field trip. The coach will leave the school gate at seven fifteen, not seven thirty as printed on the first notice. Please arrive by seven. We planned to eat beside the lake, but recent rain has made that ground too wet. Lunch will now be in the visitor centre. Bring a waterproof jacket and a notebook. The school will provide maps, so you do not need to print one. We expect to return at five forty-five, although heavy traffic could delay us by fifteen minutes.

recordings.title: Part-time café rota
recordings.transcript_en: Manager: Mina, can we discuss next week’s rota? You asked to avoid Tuesday evening because of your class. Mina: Yes, but the class has moved to Wednesday this week. I can work Tuesday after all. Manager: That helps. Could you do Tuesday from four until nine, then? Mina: Certainly. I cannot start Thursday at four, though, because my exam ends at four thirty. Manager: Start at five thirty on Thursday. Sam can cover the first hour and a half. Mina: Thanks. Shall I still open the café on Saturday? Manager: No, Priya will open. Please take the midday shift from twelve until five.

recordings.title: Museum audio guide
recordings.transcript_en: Welcome to the Riverside Museum. The ground-floor photography gallery is temporarily closed while new lights are installed. Begin your visit in the local history room on the first floor. At eleven thirty, a curator will give a free talk there about the city’s bridges. The talk was originally advertised for Gallery Two, but it has moved because that room holds a school workshop today. Large bags must be left in the lockers near reception. The lockers take a one-pound coin, which is returned when you collect your bag. The museum café closes at four, one hour before the galleries.

recordings.title: Course registration call
recordings.transcript_en: Adviser: Language Centre, how may I help? Caller: I registered for Intermediate French, but my confirmation says Monday morning. I work then. Adviser: Let me check. The Tuesday evening class is full, but there are two places on Thursday evening. Caller: Thursday is possible. Does it still begin at half past six? Adviser: It now begins at six fifteen and finishes at eight fifteen. The course starts on the twelfth of September. Caller: Fine. I already paid the full fee online. Adviser: I can transfer the payment. I will email a new confirmation today. Please reply before noon tomorrow, or the place will be released.

recordings.title: Campus sustainability briefing
recordings.transcript_en: This term the university is changing its recycling system. Blue bins will remain for paper and card, while new green bins are for clean glass and metal. Food packaging with grease must go into general waste because it contaminates recyclable material. Last year the university increased the number of bins, but recycling rates did not improve. A survey showed that unclear labels were the main problem. Therefore, every bin will now carry a large picture label, and student volunteers will answer questions during the first two weeks. The target is to reduce general waste by ten percent by December.

recordings.title: Flat viewing arrangement
recordings.transcript_en: Agent: I can show you the Park Road flat tomorrow at ten. Tenant: I have a dental appointment then. Could we meet after lunch? Agent: I am booked at one, but two thirty is free. Tenant: That works. The advert says the flat is furnished. Does that include a desk? Agent: There is a dining table but no desk. The landlord will add one if you sign a twelve-month contract. For a six-month contract, the rent is twenty pounds more each week and no desk is included. Tenant: I expect to stay for a year. Is bicycle storage available? Agent: Yes, behind the building. Bring photo identification to the viewing if you want to apply immediately.

recordings.title: Research project briefing
recordings.transcript_en: For your urban-noise project, work in groups of three. Each group will compare two locations: one busy road and one quiet residential street. Record sound levels for ten minutes at each place, once in the morning and once in the evening. Do not stand closer than five metres to a junction, because accelerating vehicles can distort the comparison. Upload your measurements by Friday the eighteenth. Your first chart is due then, but the written discussion is not due until the following Monday. If rain is heavy, postpone the recording; water can damage the meters and change traffic noise.
